sections.text_helper: Section 35.9.20 "TIM multilevel protection register 2 (TIM_MPR2)" in chapter 35 (General purpose timers (TIM15/TIM16/TIM17)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1477.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x094
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:24 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 23:16 DBK2[7:0]: Delayed 2 Break duration
This bitfield defines the duration of the delay in Delayed 2 Break mode.
It is preloaded and can be updated during timer operation (new value taken into account
after an update event).
DBK2[7:5]=0xx => Delay2=DBK2[7:0]xtDTG with tDTG=tDTS.
DBK2[7:5]=10x => Delay2=(64+DBK2[5:0])xtDTG with tDTG=2xtDTS.
DBK2[7:5]=110 => Delay2=(32+DBK2[4:0])xtDTG with tDTG=8xtDTS.
DBK2[7:5]=111 => Delay2=(32+DBK2[4:0])xtDTG with tDTG=16xtDTS.
Note: This bit can not be modified as long as LOCK level 2 or 3 has been programmed (LOCK
bits in TIM_BDTR register).
Bits 15:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 7:0 DBK1[7:0]: Delayed 1 Break duration
This bitfield defines the duration of the delay in Delayed 1 Break mode.
It is preloaded and can be updated during timer operation (new value taken into account
after an update event).
DBK2[7:5]=0xx => Delay1=DBK2[7:0]xtDTG with tDTG=tDTS.
DBK2[7:5]=10x => Delay1=(64+DBK2[5:0])xtDTG with tDTG=2xtDTS.
DBK2[7:5]=110 => Delay1=(32+DBK2[4:0])xtDTG with tDTG=8xtDTS.
DBK2[7:5]=111 => Delay1=(32+DBK2[4:0])xtDTG with tDTG=16xtDTS.
Note: This bit can not be modified as long as LOCK level 2 or 3 has been programmed (LOCK
bits in TIM_BDTR register).
